card.name: Linking words in social-history essays
card.fires_on: Small linking words (as, to, that, a, of, not) and verb endings inside general essays on gender, religion and history. The text discusses social attitudes or how groups were viewed or treated.

modes.label: Linking word mid-clause
modes.description: A short word such as as, to, that, a or of that continues a clause about social views or duties.
modes.example: the issue of what gender one is attracted to is seen<< as>> an issue of taste or preference, rather

modes.label: Verb endings of disapproval
modes.description: The ending of a verb about devaluing or despising a group.
modes.example: - Women were deval<<ued>> - Leaders subjugated human well

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in essays about how society viewed women, religion and history, and it has no clear job.
